question.text: For Maize with MSP Rs 1,850/quintal and market price Rs 1,350/quintal, a farmer selling to the government at MSP benefits by:

answer.text: Rs 500/quintal — selling at MSP instead of the lower market price

explanation.text: The Logic: Benefit = MSP - Market Price = 1,850 - 1,350 = Rs 500/quintal. The farmer sells to the government at MSP instead of at the lower market price. The Trap: Rs 1,850 is the total selling price (not the benefit). Rs 1,350 is the market price. Rs 3,200 adds both values. The benefit is the difference between MSP and market price. Note: If the market price exceeds MSP, the farmer would simply sell in the open market rather than to the government.
